gramlot-js-server 0.2.1 is the first registry release of the two packages for JavaScript Gramlot pages. Both require the core `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.1.

## Packages

- `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server`: the Node.js and Bun host adapter. `startServer` from `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server/node` (Node.js 22, `node:http`) or `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server/bun` (`Bun.serve`).
- `@gramlot/gramlot-browser`: the exporter of a page to one HTML file, or of several pages to one static directory, that opens without a server; the Page runs in a Web Worker. Command `gramlot-browser build PAGE.js -o OUTPUT.html`.

```sh
npm install @gramlot/gramlot @gramlot/gramlot-js-server
npm install @gramlot/gramlot @gramlot/gramlot-browser
```

## Changes from the repository checkouts

- The exporter, earlier in the `gramlot-serverless` repository as `@gramlot/serverless`, joined this repository with its history and is now `@gramlot/gramlot-browser`.
- The server entry points dropped the `native` prefix of the 0.1.0 profile: `/native` → `/node`, `startNativeServer` → `startServer`. The old names are not aliases.
- The earlier PoC server (`npm start`) and the PoC showcase archive are removed; they remain in the history.

## Verified

Node.js 22 and 23.11, Bun 1.3.14, Chromium 153; the core 0.2.0 qualification covers WebKit 26.6 and Firefox 155. WebKit is not Safari; Safari is not verified.
